observed_mechanism: Without APPROVE_EVOLUTION, generated code is retained as a proposal rather than applied.
With the approval marker present, the historical system checked full-file syntax and vital symbols, made a backup, applied the change, and consumed the marker.
historical_weight: Early explicit human-in-the-loop self-modification gate; direct ancestor of later proposal/review/fencing discipline.
known_gaps: marker-file existence is not cryptographic authorization
approval is not bound to a proposal hash
AST parsing establishes syntax only, not behavioral safety
modern_inheritance_rule: Preserve as lineage and design warning only. Any current self-modification path must use proposal identity binding, scoped authority, independent verification and replayable receipts.
